name: Soft Spherical Voronoi View-Dependent Color
definition: A view-dependent color model using a soft spherical Voronoi diagram with K sites on the unit sphere, allowing a single surfel to hold both broad diffuse shifts and sharp highlights.
summary: Soft Spherical Voronoi View-Dependent Color is a stable view-dependent color model that partitions directional space into learnable regions, avoiding the ill-conditioned gradients and competition issues found in Spherical Gaussians and Spherical Betas.
